objective: Confirm the browse and screen capability work is correct, regression-free and merge-ready.
scope: Commit ec15538d on release/0.3.1/feat/screen in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-screen (range 3f1c135b..ec15538d), plus merges of the fff branch and the integration branch up to c6a2ac71; source diff without dist at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/screen-commit.diff; writer report /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw9trshx-cnhq.md

Requirements: opencode browse is @opencode/browse (MIT, 0.0.15, stdio MCP server plus a paired Chromium extension driving the user's real browser), registered for Pi at an exact pin moved by deps:update; setup reports when the extension is not installed or paired. Computer use is not a role but a screen capability an Assignment can carry; it grants computer-use tools (pi-computer-use), browser use (opencode browse) and the T3 in-app browser (T3 preview tools where T3 hosts the session), and routes that Assignment to GPT-6.1 Terra whatever its role, at least medium. The screen capabilities are granted per Assignment to keep specialist tool lists small. Capabilities have headless and normal forms: the screen capability uses a headless Playwright Chromium in a cloud or CI session and the paired real browser and desktop computer use on a desktop; setup and doctor detect the system and pick the form, and a capability whose needs are missing is reported, not silently dropped. Everything is modular, can be turned off on its own, with exact pins moved by deps:update.

Known gaps from the writer to judge: no headless Playwright Chromium form was built (browse drives a real browser only); browse 0.0.16 exists, the pin stays at 0.0.15; a second agent file per specialist (<agent>-screen, 36 in all) carries the screen tools; the Claude host refuses screen Assignments; the R-SCREEN requirement was added to the requirements tree and all three families.
